paragraphs.source_en: While Gotō Mototsugu fought desperately at Mount Komatsu, a fierce encounter was also raging at Yao and Wakae, sixteen ri north of the mountain.

units.source_en: While Gotō Mototsugu fought desperately at Mount Komatsu, a fierce encounter was also raging at Yao and Wakae, sixteen ri north of the mountain.
units.source_zh: 后藤基次在小松山奋战的同时，小松山北十六里处的八尾和若江，也正进行一场激烈的遭遇战。

paragraphs.source_zh: 后藤基次在小松山奋战的同时，小松山北十六里处的八尾和若江，也正进行一场激烈的遭遇战。

paragraphs.source_en: On the previous night, the fifth, the eastern armies held their final council of war at Tokugawa Ieyasu's temporary headquarters in Hoshida and discussed the coming operations in detail.

units.source_en: On the previous night, the fifth, the eastern armies held their final council of war at Tokugawa Ieyasu's temporary headquarters in Hoshida and discussed the coming operations in detail.
units.source_zh: 关东诸军在前一夜（初五），于暂驻星田的德川家康大营，召开了最后一次行军会议，对此后的作战进行了细致商讨。

paragraphs.source_zh: 关东诸军在前一夜（初五），于暂驻星田的德川家康大营，召开了最后一次行军会议，对此后的作战进行了细致商讨。

paragraphs.source_en: The vanguard at the Kawachi approach consisted of Tōdō's five thousand men and Ii's thirty-two hundred. They all knew full well that the decisive battle would come the next day, and Ieyasu's instructions were plain and direct. Thus, after the council, Tōdō Takatora returned to his camp at Senzuka and swiftly made ready, waiting only for dawn.

units.source_en: The vanguard at the Kawachi approach consisted of Tōdō's five thousand men and Ii's thirty-two hundred.

units.source_zh: 明日就要决战，他们都心知肚明，家康的吩咐更是明白直接。

units.source_zh: 因而，在会议之后，藤堂高虎便回到千冢的营帐，迅速准备，只待天明。

paragraphs.source_zh: 河内口的先锋军由藤堂的五千人马和井伊的三千二百人组成。明日就要决战，他们都心知肚明，家康的吩咐更是明白直接。因而，在会议之后，藤堂高虎便回到千冢的营帐，迅速准备，只待天明。

paragraphs.source_en: Hideyori summoned Shigenari and said, “It appears they mean to attack from Imafuku. Take your troops there at once.”

units.source_en: Hideyori summoned Shigenari and said, “It appears they mean to attack from Imafuku. Take your troops there at once.”
units.source_zh: 秀赖把重成叫去，道：“他们好像是要从今福进攻，你马上率兵前往今福。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀赖把重成叫去，道：“他们好像是要从今福进攻，你马上率兵前往今福。”

paragraphs.source_en: True to his nature, Shigenari would never disobey Hideyori's command, so he hurried to Imafuku and reconnoitered its terrain once more. Yet the place was ill suited to the passage of a large army. Why would Ieyasu, a master of field warfare, choose terrain so inconvenient for a march? They were surely still planning to follow the Kōya highway toward Dōmyōji. Shigenari could determine the direction of the enemy's attack, but he had no power to alter their route.

paragraphs.source_zh: 一句话令重成感到无比恐慌，“倘若此言属实，说不定右府也在暗中怀疑我木村重成呢。”

paragraphs.source_en: Shigenari now understood the true feelings of the dead Ban Dan'emon Naoyuki and of the still-living Sanada Yukimura and Gotō Mototsugu. All hope had died within them, and they thought only of going to their deaths. Moving though that was, it also tormented him—why did they not summon every last ounce of strength and fight their way toward life? However fiercely one's heart might burn, to abandon all effort was to accept defeat.

units.source_en: Shigenari now understood the true feelings of the dead Ban Dan'emon Naoyuki and of the still-living Sanada Yukimura and Gotō Mototsugu.
units.source_zh: 重成悟到了已死的塙团右卫门直之、活着的真田幸村与后藤基次等人的真心。

units.source_en: All hope had died within them, and they thought only of going to their deaths. Moving though that was, it also tormented him—why did they not summon every last ounce of strength and fight their way toward life?
units.source_zh: 他们万念俱灰，一心赴死，虽然令人感怀，却也让人心焦——为何他们不使出浑身解数，奋力杀出生路呢？

units.source_en: However fiercely one's heart might burn, to abandon all effort was to accept defeat.
units.source_zh: 不管心中如何慷慨激昂，放弃努力，便意味着失败。

paragraphs.source_zh: 重成悟到了已死的塙团右卫门直之、活着的真田幸村与后藤基次等人的真心。他们万念俱灰，一心赴死，虽然令人感怀，却也让人心焦——为何他们不使出浑身解数，奋力杀出生路呢？不管心中如何慷慨激昂，放弃努力，便意味着失败。

paragraphs.source_en: The words of Harufusa's messenger pierced Shigenari like a thousand arrows: had Sanada and Gotō already seen through the Minister of the Right's thoughts? Was it their intention to prove their integrity by sacrificing their lives?

units.source_en: The words of Harufusa's messenger pierced Shigenari like a thousand arrows: had Sanada and Gotō already seen through the Minister of the Right's thoughts?

paragraphs.source_en: Shigenari told the messenger that he understood Harufusa's intention, but afterward he did not go to see Hideyori; if he offered well-meant counsel only to have it rejected, the pain would be unbearable.

units.source_en: Shigenari told the messenger that he understood Harufusa's intention, but afterward he did not go to see Hideyori; if he offered well-meant counsel only to have it rejected, the pain would be unbearable.

paragraphs.source_en: But by the hour of the Rat the men had still not assembled, and it was already the hour of the Ox when they finally departed. Unlike Gotō Mototsugu's force, they marched without a single torch, allowing only the man at the head of the column to carry one dim lantern.

paragraphs.source_en: Once Kimura Nagato-no-kami Shigenari had penetrated the mystery of life and death, he displayed powers of endurance beyond those of ordinary men. Yet he was impetuous by nature, and tonight was no exception. The thought that trust between lord and retainer was ultimately limited left him faintly resentful. Whether it was Sanada Yukimura deciding before him to march on Dōmyōji or Gotō Mototsugu already setting out, both made the young man chafe with impatience: how could he allow himself to fall behind others?

paragraphs.source_en: Only then did the old farmer relax. He described a winding footpath: follow it to the Ogawa River, then continue down the riverbank, and it would lead to the marsh before Yao.

units.source_en: Only then did the old farmer relax. He described a winding footpath: follow it to the Ogawa River, then continue down the riverbank, and it would lead to the marsh before Yao.
units.source_zh: 老农这才放了心，如此这般告之一条羊肠小道，穿过那小道到小川河，然后沿小川河堤一直往下，便到了八尾前方的沼泽地。

paragraphs.source_zh: 老农这才放了心，如此这般告之一条羊肠小道，穿过那小道到小川河，然后沿小川河堤一直往下，便到了八尾前方的沼泽地。

paragraphs.source_en: Without waiting to hear the rest, Jihei spurred his horse and galloped away.

units.source_en: Without waiting to hear the rest, Jihei spurred his horse and galloped away.
units.source_zh: 不待听完，治兵卫快马加鞭，飞奔而去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 不待听完，治兵卫快马加鞭，飞奔而去。

paragraphs.source_en: In ordinary life, good or ill fortune determines whether a life is happy or unhappy; on the battlefield, it determines life or death itself. Why was Shigenari in such haste to enter a marsh from which advance and retreat were equally difficult?

units.source_en: In ordinary life, good or ill fortune determines whether a life is happy or unhappy;
units.source_zh: 寻常日子运气的好坏，关系人生幸与不幸；

units.source_en: on the battlefield, it determines life or death itself.
units.source_zh: 战场上运气的好坏，则直接关系人的生死。

units.source_en: Why was Shigenari in such haste to enter a marsh from which advance and retreat were equally difficult?
units.source_zh: 重成为何这般心急，要去一片难进难退的沼泽地？

paragraphs.source_zh: 寻常日子运气的好坏，关系人生幸与不幸；战场上运气的好坏，则直接关系人的生死。重成为何这般心急，要去一片难进难退的沼泽地？

paragraphs.source_en: Ordinarily, Kimura Shigenari possessed a caution and composure uncommon in men of his youth. Over the preceding days, he had personally inspected the terrain throughout this district.

units.source_en: Ordinarily, Kimura Shigenari possessed a caution and composure uncommon in men of his youth.
units.source_zh: 平日的木村重成，有着寻常年轻之人没有的慎重与沉着。

units.source_en: Over the preceding days, he had personally inspected the terrain throughout this district.
units.source_zh: 前几日，他都在亲自视察这一带的地形。

paragraphs.source_zh: 平日的木村重成，有着寻常年轻之人没有的慎重与沉着。前几日，他都在亲自视察这一带的地形。

paragraphs.source_en: Wakae and Yao lay about eight ri apart. Nishigōri adjoined Wakae, and south of Nishigōri stood the village of Kayafuri. Iwatamura lay north of Wakae, and Anamura north of Yao. West of Yao, across the river, stood the village of Kyūhōji. A road through the slope at Kyūhōji led directly to Osaka.

units.source_en: Wakae and Yao lay about eight ri apart.
units.source_zh: 若江和八尾约有八里之遥。

units.source_en: Nishigōri adjoined Wakae, and south of Nishigōri stood the village of Kayafuri.
units.source_zh: 与若江相连者为西郡，西郡之南有一萱振村。

units.source_en: Iwatamura lay north of Wakae, and Anamura north of Yao.
units.source_zh: 若江北为岩田村，八尾北为穴太村。

units.source_en: West of Yao, across the river, stood the village of Kyūhōji.
units.source_zh: 八尾西方，有一个久宝寺村隔河相望。

units.source_en: A road through the slope at Kyūhōji led directly to Osaka.
units.source_zh: 久宝寺村有一条路穿过斜坡，直通大坂。

paragraphs.source_zh: 若江和八尾约有八里之遥。与若江相连者为西郡，西郡之南有一萱振村。若江北为岩田村，八尾北为穴太村。八尾西方，有一个久宝寺村隔河相望。久宝寺村有一条路穿过斜坡，直通大坂。

paragraphs.source_en: Shigenari intended to take the opposite route and meet the enemy. He knew that the forces of Gotō, Sanada, and Mōri had all come this way along that slope. Fearing ridicule if he merely followed them, he deliberately chose a different route.

units.source_en: Shigenari intended to take the opposite route and meet the enemy.
units.source_zh: 重成是想走一条与此相反的路线迎击敌军。

units.source_en: He knew that the forces of Gotō, Sanada, and Mōri had all come this way along that slope. Fearing ridicule if he merely followed them, he deliberately chose a different route.
units.source_zh: 他知后藤、真田以及毛利的人马都沿着那斜坡来到此处，若是跟在他们后面，必遭人耻笑，便特意选择了一条与众不同的路线。

paragraphs.source_zh: 重成是想走一条与此相反的路线迎击敌军。他知后藤、真田以及毛利的人马都沿着那斜坡来到此处，若是跟在他们后面，必遭人耻笑，便特意选择了一条与众不同的路线。

paragraphs.source_en: This revealed Shigenari's immaturity; it also showed that Osaka's commanders lacked unified command and each acted as he pleased. War requires a single, clearly defined objective, with everyone from the commander-in-chief down to the lowliest foot soldier directed as one.

units.source_en: This revealed Shigenari's immaturity; it also showed that Osaka's commanders lacked unified command and each acted as he pleased.
units.source_zh: 由此可看出，重成还欠火候，亦可看出大坂诸将并无统一指挥，乃是各行其是。

units.source_en: War requires a single, clearly defined objective, with everyone from the commander-in-chief down to the lowliest foot soldier directed as one.

ja.t: されなければならない。

units.source_zh: 战场征伐，必须有一个明确的目标，上至总大将，下至小卒兵士，都当统一调度。

paragraphs.source_zh: 由此可看出，重成还欠火候，亦可看出大坂诸将并无统一指挥，乃是各行其是。战场征伐，必须有一个明确的目标，上至总大将，下至小卒兵士，都当统一调度。

paragraphs.source_en: Upon learning that Shigenari was advancing toward the marsh, Hiratsuka Jihei raced after him like a madman, taking a shortcut through the thin morning mist.

units.source_en: Upon learning that Shigenari was advancing toward the marsh, Hiratsuka Jihei raced after him like a madman, taking a shortcut through the thin morning mist.
units.source_zh: 得知重成正朝着沼泽地进发，平冢治兵卫如疯了一般，在薄薄的晨雾中抄近道追赶。

paragraphs.source_zh: 得知重成正朝着沼泽地进发，平冢治兵卫如疯了一般，在薄薄的晨雾中抄近道追赶。

paragraphs.source_en: Only when they were nearly at Yao did he finally catch up with Shigenari, shouting from afar, “Wait!”

units.source_en: Only when they were nearly at Yao did he finally catch up with Shigenari, shouting from afar, “Wait!”
units.source_zh: 直赶到已近八尾，他终于赶上了重成，远远喊道：“且等！”

paragraphs.source_zh: 直赶到已近八尾，他终于赶上了重成，远远喊道：“且等！”

paragraphs.source_en: At the head of the column, Shigenari heard the cry and, thinking they had met the enemy, snatched up his spear and demanded, “Who goes there?”

units.source_en: At the head of the column, Shigenari heard the cry and, thinking they had met the enemy, snatched up his spear and demanded, “Who goes there?”
units.source_zh: 队伍最前面的重成听到喊声，还以为遇上了敌人，急忙执起长枪，喝道：“来者何人？”

paragraphs.source_zh: 队伍最前面的重成听到喊声，还以为遇上了敌人，急忙执起长枪，喝道：“来者何人？”

paragraphs.source_en: “It is I, Hiratsuka Jihei.”

units.source_en: “It is I, Hiratsuka Jihei.”
units.source_zh: “在下平冢治兵卫。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “在下平冢治兵卫。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Oh, Jihei.”

units.source_en: “Oh, Jihei.”
units.source_zh: “哦，治兵卫。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “哦，治兵卫。”

paragraphs.source_en: “My lord, you must not continue. Ahead lies the marshland along the Nagase River. The enemy will not attack here; instead, our own forces will become hopelessly mired. You must go no farther.”

units.source_zh: “大人不能继续往前。

units.source_en: Ahead lies the marshland along the Nagase River.
units.source_zh: 前面乃是长濑川沿岸的沼泽地。

units.source_en: The enemy will not attack here; instead, our own forces will become hopelessly mired.

paragraphs.source_zh: “大人不能继续往前。前面乃是长濑川沿岸的沼泽地。敌军并不会攻到这里，我军反会深陷其中。万万不可再往前走。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Marshland?” Shigenari too was stunned. “This is disastrous! The country from Dōmyōji to Kokubu has already become a battlefield. I meant to hurry there as reinforcement and rode here at full speed, never imagining...”

units.source_en: “Marshland?”
units.source_zh: “沼泽地？”

units.source_en: Shigenari too was stunned. “This is disastrous!
units.source_zh: 重成也愕然，“大坏矣！

units.source_en: The country from Dōmyōji to Kokubu has already become a battlefield. I meant to hurry there as reinforcement and rode here at full speed, never imagining...”
units.source_zh: 道明寺到国分一带已成战场，本欲前去增援，快马加鞭方赶到此地，不意……”

paragraphs.source_zh: “沼泽地？”重成也愕然，“大坏矣！道明寺到国分一带已成战场，本欲前去增援，快马加鞭方赶到此地，不意……”

paragraphs.source_en: “My lord, there is no time for hesitation. Withdraw at once to Wakae and block the enemy's path there; by doing so, you can also aid our comrades at Dōmyōji. Please leave this place immediately.”

units.source_en: “My lord, there is no time for hesitation. Withdraw at once to Wakae and block the enemy's path there; by doing so, you can also aid our comrades at Dōmyōji.

units.source_zh: “大人不可再犹豫，赶快撤至若江，在那里截住敌人去路，还能助道明寺那边的弟兄一臂之力。

units.source_en: Please leave this place immediately.”
units.source_zh: 请大人快快离开此处。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “大人不可再犹豫，赶快撤至若江，在那里截住敌人去路，还能助道明寺那边的弟兄一臂之力。请大人快快离开此处。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Alas! I have charged straight into a marsh with neither advance nor retreat!” Bitterly, Shigenari wheeled his horse around. Trembling all over, he ordered the force back to Wakae.

units.source_en: “Alas!
I have charged straight into a marsh with neither advance nor retreat!”
units.source_zh: 我竟奔往进退无门的沼泽地！”

units.source_en: Bitterly, Shigenari wheeled his horse around. Trembling all over, he ordered the force back to Wakae.
units.source_zh: 重成恨恨调转了马首，浑身都在颤抖，下令回到若江。

paragraphs.source_zh: “唉！我竟奔往进退无门的沼泽地！”重成恨恨调转了马首，浑身都在颤抖，下令回到若江。

paragraphs.source_en: The road was narrow, and the dense fog that had briefly dispersed rolled in again, plunging the surroundings into gloom. Spurring his horse along the path, Shigenari tried to work his way to the head of the column. After pushing through the ranks for about two chō, he heard a burst of battle cries from the right front.

units.source_en: The road was narrow, and the dense fog that had briefly dispersed rolled in again, plunging the surroundings into gloom.
units.source_zh: 道路狭窄，一度散去的大雾再次弥漫开来，周围昏暗不已。

units.source_en: Spurring his horse along the path, Shigenari tried to work his way to the head of the column.
units.source_zh: 沿着小路，重成催马向前，试图走到队伍前头。

units.source_en: After pushing through the ranks for about two chō, he heard a burst of battle cries from the right front.
units.source_zh: 他拨开队伍走出两町左右，只听见右前方传来一阵呐喊。

paragraphs.source_zh: 道路狭窄，一度散去的大雾再次弥漫开来，周围昏暗不已。沿着小路，重成催马向前，试图走到队伍前头。他拨开队伍走出两町左右，只听见右前方传来一阵呐喊。

paragraphs.source_en: Shigenari reined in and listened intently. Could the enemy have caught up while his force was advancing? Only then did a chill of terror run through him.

units.source_en: Shigenari reined in and listened intently.
units.source_zh: 重成勒住马凝神细听。

units.source_en: Could the enemy have caught up while his force was advancing?
units.source_zh: 莫非自己进军之时，敌军已经追了上来？

units.source_en: Only then did a chill of terror run through him.
units.source_zh: 此时，重成才感到毛骨悚然。

paragraphs.source_en: If so, the pursuers must be the Tokugawa vanguard deployed at the Kawachi approach: Tōdō Takatora and Ii Naotaka's Red Armored troops, both masters of commanding men in open battle. Were his men to be driven by the enemy into the marsh here?

units.source_en: If so, the pursuers must be the Tokugawa vanguard deployed at the Kawachi approach: Tōdō Takatora and Ii Naotaka's Red Armored troops, both masters of commanding men in open battle.
units.source_zh: 若真如此，追兵定是德川方布防于河内口的先锋藤堂高虎与井伊直孝的赤备军，此二人是善于统兵野战的高手。

units.source_en: Were his men to be driven by the enemy into the marsh here?

paragraphs.source_zh: 若真如此，追兵定是德川方布防于河内口的先锋藤堂高虎与井伊直孝的赤备军，此二人是善于统兵野战的高手。难道己方要在此地被敌军追赶，陷入沼泽？
